pump_93.why: 8.5:1 on 93. Without WMI, plan 22 psi. WMI at ≥22 psi / ≥3500 rpm buys IAT and timing toward 27.

mix_50_50.why: 50/50 93+E85 is ~E42. Mid octane. 25 psi dry, 30 psi with WMI once RPM ≥4000.

e85.why: E85 is hardware-limited. WMI at ≥27 psi / ≥4500 rpm is IAT margin so 28–30 psi can hold farther into the redline band.

ecu.drive: GP Output → relay coil (low-side Aux or switchboard output when one is free)
ecu.optional_level_di: use a free DI later for tank empty — do not take a live DI

wmi.why_gates: Spray only where T2/IAT and cylinder pressure need it. 93 gates earliest (knock). E42 in the middle. E85 last (compressor-outlet heat at high PR × high flow). Cold IAT and part-throttle stay dry so the tank lasts and the charge is not over-wet at idle.

activation_chart.why: 8.5:1 on 93. Without WMI, plan 22 psi. WMI at ≥22 psi / ≥3500 rpm buys IAT and timing toward 27.
50/50 93+E85 is ~E42. Mid octane. 25 psi dry, 30 psi with WMI once RPM ≥4000.
E85 is hardware-limited. WMI at ≥27 psi / ≥4500 rpm is IAT margin so 28–30 psi can hold farther into the redline band.

headline.note: Dry crank uses hp/lb-min (10 / 10.5 / 11) and stops at that fuel's knock ceiling (22 / 25 / 30 psi). WMI adds 0.40 / 0.25 / 0.15 hp/lb-min when the gate is true and may raise the ceiling (27 / 30 / 30). Wheel uses 17% AWD loss. Headlines are from the Phase-1 rpm×boost grid so 93 dry is not taken from a 27 psi MatchBot point.

turbo_fit.EFR_7064: 55 lb/min @ PR 3.0 is the published 56 lb/min wall. Choke.
turbo_fit.EFR_7163: 55 lb/min sits on the right side of a 60 lb/min map.
turbo_fit.EFR_7670: 55 lb/min is inside a 64 lb/min map.
turbo_fit.recommendation: Keep 7163-G for a road car. Step to 7670-C to hold 30 psi to 7500+ in-island. 7064 is the wrong compressor.
